_meta.coverage_keys: every row carries values_dispatched / distinct_bytes / encodable_range / start / width / coverage_pct / thin / under_covered. THIN = values_dispatched < encodable_range. UNDER-COVERED = distinct_bytes < values_dispatched, which is the only signal that a sweep dispatched values it never actually encoded (DEF-0166-1).
_meta.foreign_fields: `dst` on every descriptor is EXP-0168's verdict (coordinator directive 2026-08-30). Swept here as this experiment's detection instrument; NO verdict emitted.
_meta.gate: cross-run agreement >= 99% AND min(movedA,movedB) >= 2.0 x disagreements, over >= 2 common values; the (arm,carrier) liveness ladder must have passed first
_meta.pairing: per field, the two runs with the most distinct attributed values (EXP-0164 cross_run's own rule), so an arm captured in a separate later pair is not diluted by the earlier one

calibration.async_note: device_load on G17P is ASYNCHRONOUS and this harness issues no wait/scoreboard barrier. The number of landed registers grows monotonically with filler instructions inserted between the loads and their use: F=0,2,4,8 -> 0 of 8 landed; F=16 -> 2; F=32 -> 5; F=64 -> 8; F=128 -> 8. See raw/pilot03/calibprobe2.jsonl.
calibration.evidence: device_load idx_off unit = 1 WORD, HW-VALIDATED on G17P: with sufficient filler between issue and use, r_k loaded at idx_off k reads ramp word k for every k in 0..13 (E1 F=64 and F=128: 8 of 8; E2: 14 of 14 on five consecutive repeats). Note this is a DIFFERENT unit from device_store, whose idx_off unit is 4 words (EXP-0090/EXP-0119, isa_helpers.STORE_STRIDE_WORDS).
calibration.measured_by: raw/pilot03 (calibprobe2.py) E1 F=64 and F=128, and raw/pilot03 E2 x5
calibration.note: device_load idx_off unit in WORDS, solved from a ramp image in which every word is self-identifying. Frozen here BEFORE the gated runs; the C2_load semantic oracle depends on it.
calibration.supersedes: harness/smoke.py S3, which could not solve the unit: its solver read all-zero registers because its hand-built program placed the dump immediately after the loads, with no slack. Retained unedited in raw/pilot01/.
